entity.title: Personal conduct
entity.description: How an agent that acts on a member's behalf behaves for that member, with the history of the member's own changes; kept and changed in the cm.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The agent that acts on the member's behalf and whose conduct this is.

person.title: Member
person.description: The organization member this conduct applies to; always the person signed in.

summary.title: Current conduct
summary.description: How the agent currently behaves for this member, in plain language, as the cm returns it.

changeRequest.title: What do you want to change
changeRequest.description: What the member writes should change in how the agent behaves for them; sent to the cm, which updates only this member's conduct.

history.title: History of my changes
history.description: The member's own changes to this conduct, newest first, as the cm lists them.

changedBy.title: Who
changedBy.description: Who made the change; the member themselves.
